form.label: Remote Execution
form.description: Someone running commands on a Windows box from another machine.

html.p: Severity 6. A new service runs cmd, a .bat file or PowerShell. smbexec makes one per command. Playbook steps (page 4) · Run the scope search

search.query: `windows_system` EventCode=7045 (Service_File_Name="*COMSPEC*" OR Service_File_Name="*cmd*" OR Service_File_Name="*.bat*" OR Service_File_Name="*powershell*") | table _time host Service_Name Service_File_Name Service_Account

panel.title: Alert: smbexec cmd started by services.exe

html.p: Severity 5. cmd or PowerShell started directly by services.exe: smbexec's service actually running. Playbook steps (page 5) · Run the scope search

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 ParentImage="*services.exe" Image IN ("*cmd.exe","*powershell.exe","*pwsh.exe") | table _time host User ParentImage Image CommandLine

panel.title: Alert: Shell under WMI, WinRM or Task Scheduler

html.p: Severity 4. A shell or script host started by WMI (wmiexec), WinRM or Task Scheduler (atexec). Playbook steps (page 5)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*WmiPrvSE.exe" OR ParentImage="*wsmprovhost.exe" OR ParentImage="*taskeng.exe" OR ParentCommandLine="*-s Schedule*") Image IN ("*cmd.exe","*powershell.exe","*pwsh.exe","*wscript.exe","*cscript.exe","*mshta.exe","*rundll32.exe") | table _time host User ParentImage Image CommandLine

panel.title: Alert: Batch file written to Windows Temp

html.p: Severity 4. A .bat file appeared in C:\Windows\Temp, like smbexec's temporary batch file. Playbook steps (page 6)

search.query: `windows_sysmon` EventCode=11 TargetFilename="*Windows*Temp*.bat" | table _time host User Image TargetFilename

html.p: Severity 4. Someone ran whoami, usually an attacker's first command after getting a shell. Playbook steps (page 6)

search.query: (`windows_sysmon` EventCode=1 Image="*whoami.exe") OR (`windows_security` EventCode=4688 New_Process_Name="*whoami.exe") | eval user=coalesce(User, mvindex(Account_Name,0)), parent=coalesce(ParentImage, Creator_Process_Name), command=coalesce(CommandLine, Process_Command_Line) | table _time host user parent command source

panel.title: Network logons: who, and from where

search.query: `windows_security` EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=3 | eval user=mvindex(Account_Name,-1) | search NOT user="*$$" NOT user="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats count latest(_time) as last by host user Source_Network_Address | sort - last | convert ctime(last)
